elements.text:
1. Fill ballasts untill top antenae are 
underwater then you can stop and
throttle up

2. Sub will barely move with max
throttle untill it is completely
submerged, then it will speed up.

3. after ownerpad reset, the top ballast
will often fill with water
for some reason, if this happens
the sub will rapidly sink, in order
to reset this, go up into the top
section towards the front past the pumps, 
and you
will see the pressure interface thing,
set fill with vaccum and you
will be good to go.
4. Pitch while moving is w/s, and yaw is
a/d, these will not work while sub is
stationary, and the yaw will
turn the sub a little but it will
even out with time.
